race.title: Winter Ladies Day Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NORTHWEST PASSAGE 's opening mark over hurdles is an attractive one given his ability on the Flat so gets the vote. Promethean looks to be building up to something so is second choice ahead of penalised winner Character Testing . NORTHWEST PASSAGE PROMETHEAN (FR) CHARACTER TESTING
